Utility 2025 Integrated Resource Plans and press releases

Jul-2026 status refresh: V.C. Summer FID timeline (SC Daily Gazette 2026-07-07), Palisades/Crane restart milestones, TVA Clinch River CP recommendation (ANS Jun 2026), Duke Belews Creek ESP (Federal Register 2026-02-11)

Sep-2026 status refresh: Palisades fuel-loading incident (The National, 2026-09-21), Crane final EA/FONSI (Federal Register, 2026-09-22), Clinch River mandatory hearing held (NRC PMNS 20260617), Belews Creek mandatory hearing held (NRC, 2026-09-17), Project Matador TensorWave lease + construction update (Fermi America IR, 2026-08-10), Kewaunee NOI clarified as new-build not restart (EnergySolutions, 2026-01-15)

Oct-2026 refresh: Kemmerer construction permit (World Nuclear News, 2026-03-05), Clinch River construction permit (World Nuclear News, 2026-09-30); population-center distances from Census Vintage 2024 place estimates

sites.name: Palisades
sites.notes: Restart of existing reactor (~800 MW), not an AP1000 deployment. Fuel loading into the 204-assembly core began 2026-08-30; one fuel assembly tilted after being set down and the grapple released, pausing fuel loading. NRC says the incident did not trigger safety-reporting requirements, with no radiological release and no injuries. Holtec plans to submit a license amendment for the retrieval process; no firm restart date as of 2026-09-25 (previously 'this year or early 2027').

sites.name: Three Mile Island Unit 1
sites.notes: Crane Clean Energy Center restart, Microsoft PPA. NRC draft EA/FONSI Jun 8 2026; NRC and DOE issued the final EA and Finding of No Significant Impact 2026-09-22, on schedule; 760 MW of Eddystone capacity-interconnection rights transferred Jun 2026. Operating-license decision still estimated around May 2027, with power potentially later that year.

sites.name: Duane Arnold
sites.notes: Feasibility study for possible restart underway. Cooling tower repairs needed.

sites.name: Kemmerer (Natrium)
sites.notes: TerraPower's Natrium advanced reactor. NRC approved the Kemmerer Unit 1 construction permit (reported 2026-03-05).

sites.name: Seadrift (X-energy)
sites.notes: DOE ARDP project. Behind-the-meter for Dow chemical manufacturing. NRC pre-application activities.

sites.name: Clinch River
sites.notes: NRC early site permit, then a construction permit for TVA's BWRX-300 (reported 2026-09-30), the first US construction permit for this SMR design.

sites.name: Belews Creek (Duke ESP)
sites.notes: ESP filed Dec 30 2025 at the Belews Creek coal-plant site (accepted by NRC Feb 8 2026); NRC held its mandatory hearing 2026-09-17 in Danbury, NC; final SER + EIS still targeted May 2027. If confirmed best-value: first SMR online 2036, 600 MW plant by 2037. Coal-to-nuclear pattern on an operating coal site.

sites.name: INL / Former CFPP Site
sites.notes: Carbon Free Power Project (CFPP) — Idaho Power withdrew in 2023; site characterization work done. NuScale design certified. Idaho Advanced Nuclear Task Force (EO 2025-06) supports new deployment.

sites.name: Columbia Generating Station
sites.reactor_type: Xe-100 (2nd project, in addition to existing BWR)
sites.notes: Existing BWR operating. X-energy 2nd project co-located. AP1000 is also feasible.

sites.name: V.C. Summer Units 2 & 3
sites.developer: Brookfield Asset Management / The Nuclear Company
sites.notes: Fastest AP1000 deployment path given prior licensing and ~40% construction. COL issued then terminated. Brookfield MOU Dec 2025 ($2.7B); The Nuclear Company joined the JV May 2026. Milestones: DOE loan application by end-2026, operator selection by Feb 2027, FID disclosed by 2028-03-31 (SC Daily Gazette, Jul 2026).

sites.name: Turkey Point Units 6 & 7
sites.notes: Two-unit AP1000 COL issued 2019. Land and water availability may require analysis given South Florida setting.

sites.name: William States Lee III
sites.notes: New greenfield site. COL issued 2016. Duke's 2025 resource plan identifies this as best suited for new large LWR, targeting 2037 in-service.

sites.name: Levy (Crystal River)
sites.notes: New greenfield site. COL issued then terminated. COL reinstatement feasible.

sites.name: Bellefonte
sites.notes: TVA abandoned AP1000 plan (2021). Units 1&2 are partially-built B&W PWRs (Unit 1 ~88% complete). 1,600-acre site on Tennessee River. COL application withdrawn. AP1000 COL reinstatement or new application feasible.

sites.name: Fermi Energy Center
sites.notes: Existing BWR operating at site. Single-unit ESBWR COL issued. Changing to AP1000 would require COL amendment. DTE exploring options.

sites.name: Shearon Harris
sites.notes: Existing PWR operating. Two-unit AP1000 COL application suspended. Duke's 2025 plan includes this site for potential large LWR. COL revision needed.

sites.name: South Texas Project
sites.notes: Two existing PWRs operating. Two-unit ABWR COL issued. Changing to AP1000 feasible. ERCOT market.

sites.name: North Anna
sites.notes: Two existing PWRs operating. Single-unit ESBWR COL issued. Dominion exploring advanced nuclear (Amazon SMR partnership 2024). AP1000 change feasible.

sites.name: Comanche Peak
sites.notes: Two existing PWRs operating. Two-unit APWR COL application suspended. ERCOT market, high demand growth. AP1000 change feasible.

sites.name: River Bend
sites.notes: Existing BWR operating. Single-unit ESBWR COL application withdrawn. Resubmission as AP1000 feasible.

sites.name: Calvert Cliffs
sites.notes: Two existing PWRs operating. Single-unit EPR COL application withdrawn. AP1000 substitution feasible.

sites.name: Callaway
sites.notes: Existing PWR operating. Single-unit EPR COL application withdrawn. AP1000 substitution feasible.

sites.name: Grand Gulf
sites.notes: Existing BWR operating. Single-unit ESBWR COL application withdrawn. Large site on Mississippi River.

sites.name: Bell Bend
sites.notes: New greenfield site adjacent to Susquehanna nuclear station. Single-unit EPR COL application withdrawn. AP1000 substitution feasible.

sites.name: Nine Mile Point
sites.notes: Two existing BWRs operating. Single-unit EPR COL application withdrawn. Previous retirement risk. AP1000 substitution feasible.

sites.name: Victoria County Station
sites.notes: New greenfield site. Two-unit ESBWR COL/ESP application withdrawn. Site viability still possible. ERCOT market, high demand.

sites.name: Salem / Hope Creek
sites.notes: Three existing reactors (Salem 1&2 PWR + Hope Creek BWR). ESP approved. New state approval of waste plan required before new reactor build. Previous retirement risk (mitigated).

sites.name: Brunswick
sites.notes: No identified AP1000 issues but no previous licensing work.

sites.name: Browns Ferry
sites.notes: Three BWRs operating. No previous new-build licensing work.

sites.name: Watts Bar
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. No previous new-build licensing work.

sites.name: Wolf Creek
sites.notes: Single PWR operating. No previous new-build licensing work.

sites.name: Waterford
sites.notes: Single PWR operating. No previous new-build licensing work.

sites.name: Cooper
sites.notes: Single BWR operating. No previous new-build licensing work.

sites.name: Surry
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. No previous new-build licensing work. Dominion exploring small-scale SMR.

sites.name: Point Beach
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. No previous new-build licensing work.

sites.name: Susquehanna
sites.notes: Two BWRs operating. No previous new-build licensing work. AWS Direct Air Capture co-location announced 2024.

sites.name: Vogtle
sites.notes: Four AP1000s operating (Units 1-4). Additional units possible. Georgia PSC concerns about cost overrun protection.

sites.name: Hatch
sites.notes: Two BWRs operating. No previous new-build licensing work. Same Georgia PSC cost-protection concern as Vogtle.

sites.name: Palo Verde
sites.notes: Three PWRs operating. Largest nuclear plant in US. May be water limited (uses treated municipal wastewater — already fully committed). APS exploring SLR.

sites.name: Farley
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be water limited.

sites.name: Catawba
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: Oconee
sites.notes: Three PWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: Peach Bottom
sites.notes: Two BWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: St. Lucie
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited. NRC recently approved 80-year operation.

sites.name: Donald C. Cook
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: Arkansas Nuclear One (ANO)
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: Sequoyah
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: Robinson
sites.notes: Single PWR operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: Seabrook
sites.notes: Single PWR operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: McGuire
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited.

sites.name: FitzPatrick
sites.notes: Single BWR operating. Previous retirement risk (addressed).

sites.name: Perry
sites.notes: Single BWR operating. Previous retirement risk.

sites.name: R.E. Ginna
sites.notes: Single PWR operating. May be land limited. Previous retirement risk.

sites.name: Beaver Valley
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. May be land limited. Previous retirement risk.

sites.name: Davis-Besse
sites.notes: Single PWR operating. May be land limited. Previous retirement risk.

sites.name: Millstone
sites.notes: Two PWRs operating. CT law limits new build to only the Millstone location. May be land limited. Previous retirement risk (Dominion sold back to CT state).

sites.name: Clinton
sites.notes: ESP approved. Illinois policy limits new large reactor builds to SMR-only. Could host AP1000 with policy change.

sites.name: LaSalle
sites.notes: Illinois SMR-only policy.

sites.name: Braidwood
sites.notes: Illinois SMR-only policy. Announced uprates to existing units.

sites.name: Dresden
sites.notes: Illinois SMR-only policy. Previous retirement risk.

sites.name: Byron
sites.notes: Illinois SMR-only policy. Announced uprates.

sites.name: Quad Cities
sites.notes: Illinois SMR-only policy. May also be land limited. Previous retirement risk.

sites.name: Monticello
sites.notes: Minnesota moratorium on new nuclear power plants. Could become viable with policy change.

sites.name: Prairie Island
sites.notes: Minnesota moratorium. Could become viable with policy change.

sites.name: Diablo Canyon
sites.notes: California moratorium. Existing units extended 2022. New build prohibited under current state law.

sites.name: Limerick
sites.notes: Two BWRs operating. Site is land limited; population near plant has grown significantly. Not suitable for large new build.

sites.name: Project Matador (Fermi America)
sites.notes: Four-unit AP1000, air-cooled (<50 ac-ft/yr water). Behind-the-meter model for data centers. COLA filed June 17, 2025; NRC-accepted. Preliminary site work began 2025; per Fermi's own 2026-08-10 release, vertical construction is underway, ~$1.5B invested to date, ~6 GW of the planned 17 GW campus permitted. First tenant lease signed 2026-08-10 (TensorWave, $6.5B/222 MW). Agreement with Doosan Enerbility. Greenfield site, Carson County TX. Not in INL 2024 study.

sites.name: Kewaunee
sites.notes: Former 556 MWe PWR (retired 2013). EnergySolutions submitted its NOI to the NRC 2026-01-15 confirming plans to pursue NEW nuclear generation at the site — not a restart of the retired unit. Evaluating ESP, construction permit, or COL; per EnergySolutions, application targeted by June 2028, construction in the early 2030s, in service by 2038. Decommissioning ongoing; site infrastructure partially intact. Not in INL 2024 study.
